source_title: Perrigo Announces Agreement to Divest Infant Formula Business to MeridianMade - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Advances Streamline pillar of Perrigo's Three-S plan through portfolio simplification
Furthers Perrigo's evolution into a simpler, more focused consumer self-care company
Expected to enhance Perrigo's margin profile and eliminate significant expected future capital expenditures
Aligns reported results more closely with the financial profile of Core Perrigo
MeridianMade's infant-grade, American manufacturing infrastructure and operating capabilities will support the continued supply of safe, high-quality, and affordable infant nutrition
DUBLIN , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Perrigo Company plc (NYSE: PRGO ) ("Perrigo" or "the Company"), a leading provider of consumer self-care products, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement pursuant to which MeridianMade, an American contract manufacturing platform dedicated to infant nutrition, will acquire Perrigo's Infant Formula business for total consideration of up to $175 million. The transaction consists of $40 million in cash at closing and up to an additional $135 million contingent on the achievement of future performance milestones through 2030.
This divestiture advances Perrigo's evolution into a more focused consumer self-care company with a diversified portfolio of OTC products addressing essential, everyday health needs. The agreement follows a comprehensive review of strategic alternatives for the Infant Formula business and reflects careful consideration of the best path forward for the business and its stakeholders. MeridianMade is a company built entirely around infant nutrition with a singular focus on providing safe, high-quality formula to families and caregivers, with the infant-grade, domestic infrastructure and operating capabilities to support that aim.
"Today's announcement marks an important milestone in advancing the Streamline pillar of our Three-S plan to Stabilize, Streamline, and Strengthen the business," said Albert Manzone, Interim President and Chief Executive Officer. "For Perrigo, this transaction is expected to enhance our margin profile, materially reduce expected future capital expenditures, and enable us to concentrate resources on strengthening our core consumer self-care portfolio. Our Infant Formula colleagues have worked with tremendous dedication to enhance performance and improve operations, which has positioned Infant Formula well for its next chapter. We are confident that with its singular focus on infant nutrition and commitment to quality, safety, and continuity, MeridianMade is the right manufacturer to carry this important category forward."
Ron Belldegrun, CEO of MeridianMade, and Mia Funt, President of MeridianMade, said, "This acquisition is a commitment to responsible stewardship of store-brand infant formulas, which offer American families a more affordable option for safe, high-quality infant nutrition. We look forward to working with the Perrigo team throughout the transition and continuing to support this critical source of infant nutrition."
Until closing, Perrigo's Infant Formula business and MeridianMade will continue to operate as independent companies, and Perrigo will continue to own and operate the Infant Formula business with the same focus on safety, quality, reliable supply, and customer service. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027. The transaction is subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
As a result of the transaction, Perrigo's future reported results are expected to more closely reflect the financial profile of Core Perrigo, which Perrigo management believes will provide a clearer view of its ongoing business. Core Perrigo excludes Infant Formula and certain previously announced divestitures and exited products. Infant Formula will continue to be reported in All In results for the third quarter of 2026. Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026, Infant Formula will be included in discontinued operations. In connection with the announced transaction, the Company expects to record a non-cash impairment charge in the fourth quarter of 2026 in the range of $275 to $375 million. In the trailing four quarters ended June 27, 2026, Infant Formula generated net sales of $380 million and segment adjusted operating income of $8 million. The transaction is expected to significantly reduce Perrigo's future capital expenditure requirements.
Net proceeds from the transaction are expected to be used in accordance with Perrigo's capital allocation priorities.
Goldman Sachs is serving as financial advisor and A&O Shearman is serving as legal advisor for Perrigo. Jefferies LLC is serving as financial advisor and Sullivan and Cromwell LLP is serving as legal advisor to MeridianMade.
